experiment: primary RD-resolution study, fixed 1.0x stride-1 KuRALSNetNPUSeg

protocol.fp32_lr_source: arm A2, locked in summaries/resolution_fixed_w1_FINAL_PROTOCOL.md; in pipeline.py LR_GRID; identical at all three resolutions
protocol.qat_lr_selection: per resolution on seed 42 by validation mIoU
protocol.exclusion_rule: NONE -- every launched run is reported; med10 is a diagnostic column
protocol.selection: best validation mIoU; test read once at that checkpoint
protocol.dataset: KuRALS-CW, existing chronological 80/10/10, existing block-max-pooled RD grids

supersedes: the fixed-32-KiB co-design search (varied width/stride) and the lr-1e-3 arm

definition.cells: feature-map positions for ONE channel; multiply by the padded channel count for bytes at 1 B/activation
definition.partial_sum_cells_per_channel: largest single-layer output map, i.e. the accumulation high-water mark
definition.line_buffer_cells: (kernel-1) input rows of the widest layer input
definition.upsample_output_cells: cells after the fused 2x nearest upsample of the deepest hop that actually strides
definition.frame_reuse_cells: H*W input cells of one RD frame, the frame-reuse working set
definition.handoff_phase2: frame_reuse_cells is the handoff's MAX_OBUFF_SZ (512/1024/2048) and upsample_input_cells is its upsample depth (128/256/512)

release_checkpoint.rule: highest VALIDATION mIoU among the QAT final seeds; test read once at that checkpoint

qat_stability.qat_start: iteration 0 of the fine-tune (no float warm-up; fine-tune starts from the best FP32 checkpoint)
qat_stability.bn_freeze: none: BN is folded from running statistics at every forward; BN not frozen
qat_stability.fake_quant: int8 symmetric per-tensor activations (EMA observers), per-channel weights with hardware w_eff=2*w+1, int16 scale/bias, truncating shifts bias_shift in [5,20], act_shift in [0,7]; stem input scale fixed to 1.0 (DSP log code)
